hero.title: Find the right <highlight>master's in Europe</highlight> for you.
hero.subtitle: EdFind matches Turkish students to vetted European master's programs using a short quiz, your priorities, and an AI that explains why each program fits — not just which ones rank highest.
hero.signedInNote: Signed in — your matches travel with you across devices.
hero.signedOutNote: Sign in with Google · Takes about 2 minutes · We never silently boost partner universities
hero.step1: Tell us about yourself — {totalSteps} quick questions, or just describe what you're looking for in your own words.
hero.step2: We compare your profile against every program in our catalog — {countries} countries, real tuition, deadlines, and rankings — and pick your top 3, each with a personal explanation of why it fits (and where the trade-offs are).
hero.step3: Go deeper: compare options, check housing costs and verified student insights, then track your applications in one place.

welcome.title: Welcome to EdFind 👋
welcome.description: Your AI guide to master's programs in Europe — scattered university info, gathered in one place and matched to you.

quiz.title: Take a short quiz
quiz.description: Answer about a dozen quick questions — plus optional free-text notes for anything we'd miss. Our AI ranks your top 3 programs and explains why each one fits you.

search.title: Or say it in your own words
search.description: Type something like "affordable CS master's in the Netherlands, taught in English" and AI search turns it into real matches.

catalog.title: Explore the full catalog
catalog.description: Every university and program we cover, filterable by country, field, language, and duration. Once you're in, Ctrl+K opens search from anywhere.

shortlist.title: Save and compare
shortlist.description: Save programs you like — they land in your applications tracker — then put them side by side: tuition, deadlines, language, rankings.

applications.title: Track your applications
applications.description: A personal dashboard with progress, deadlines, and a task board so nothing slips through the cracks.

community.title: Hear it from real students
community.description: University and program groups, honest reviews, and campus responsibles who have been where you are going.

cta.title: Let's find your program
cta.description: It takes about two minutes to get your first matches. We compare objectively — and never silently boost anyone.

quizDemo.footer: A shortened preview — the real quiz is {totalSteps} quick questions and takes about 2 minutes.

destination.legend: Which destination feels right for your master's journey?
destination.helper: Pick one or more — or "No preference" to stay open.

situation.legend: What best describes your current situation?

studied.helper: Your undergraduate field, in your own words.
studied.typed: BSc Industrial Engineering at Istanbul Technical University

wantToStudy.legend: What do you want to study?
wantToStudy.helper: Be as free as you like — a field, a precise topic, or just a feeling.
wantToStudy.typed: I want to move into data science — ideally applied to supply chains

finale.title: …and that's when the matching happens
finale.description: Your answers are compared against all 196 programs — real tuition, deadlines, and rankings — and you get your top 3 with a personal explanation for each.

meta.title: Find programs — EdFind
meta.description: Pick how you want EdFind to surface your master's program matches: structured quiz, or describe what you want in your own words.

start.badge: Two paths to the same matcher
start.title: How would you like to <highlight>find your matches</highlight>?
start.subtitle: Both paths lead to the same matches from the same program catalog — pick whichever feels easier. You can always switch.

quiz.title: Take the {totalSteps}-question quiz
quiz.description: Walk through {totalSteps} quick questions covering your situation, university, background, what you want to study, GPA, budget, and goals — mostly single taps, plus a few short text answers. Best if you're still figuring out what you want.
bullets: Mostly taps — a school search and a few short text boxes
Same AI matcher under the hood

search.title: Describe what you want
search.description: Type a few sentences in your own words — "MSc in data science in Northern Europe, under 15k, English-taught" — and we'll extract the structured profile and match against it.

footer.title: Both paths produce the same kind of result.
footer.description: You'll see three ranked program matches with a personal rationale for each. We never silently boost partner universities, and you can always re-take the quiz or rewrite your description to get fresh matches.
